title: Governor on self-generated Qwen3-1.7B samples, private-test labels

invalidation.what: decision_features() read the 11 static/AST features as precomputed row columns via last.get(k, 0.0). E0029 generation rows carry `code` and no such columns, so every static feature was 0.0 for all 4750 samples.
invalidation.consequence: the run tested 5 distinct observables (pub_frac, latency, runtime_error, timeout, compile_error), NOT the 25-feature trajectory+static set it was designed around. The static family is precisely what E0028 added to escape data starvation, and it was never measured.
invalidation.detected_by: scripts/e0029_diagnose.py, which reported 17 of 25 features constant at the allocation point
invalidation.missed_warning: gate 1 printed 'public signal mutated -> 3 feature values moved' out of 25. The number was low because most of the vector was dead. It was not chased.

what_remains_valid: the 4750 generation rows -- untouched by the defect
the 4750 private-test grades -- computed from code, not features
gate 0 data integrity: 475 problems, split 250/225, one model
gate 2 ceiling +0.1378 -- derived from the hidden label alone
what_is_invalid: gate 3 allocation-point AUC 0.415 -- computed on a feature vector that was 44% dead
any claim that observable features cannot separate at the allocation point
notes: PRESERVED DELIBERATELY. This record is not rewritten and not deleted. A defect found after a result is published is part of the record, and the project has previously had to withdraw results; hiding the withdrawn version is how that becomes unauditable.
